_comment: Ground-truth PII labels for synthetic fixtures. Used by Phase 2-6 tests to assert recognizer accuracy. Each entry is the substring that MUST be detected (any entity_type is acceptable as long as the span is caught). False-negative count > 0 fails the recognizer test.
_fixture_note: Both files are entirely synthetic — names like 'John Smith' and '张三' are placeholders, SSN/ID numbers do NOT correspond to real persons. Safe to check into the repo. Do NOT replace with real PII.
